verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents scene-level revision for Video Agent videos: you can 'revise only the scenes you name,' and untouched scenes keep their script and visuals. That covers the regenerate-one-segment half of the story, but nothing in the pack shows extending a clip. The docs also don't make clear whether the final output avoids a full re-render. Missing for 10: clip extension capability, explicit confirmation that only changed segments are re-rendered, scene revision outside the Video Agent flow, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
